catalog_opening_hours_validity_check.name: catalog_opening_hours_validity_check
catalog_opening_hours_validity_check.value: "catalog_opening_hours"."valid_from" is null or "catalog_opening_hours"."valid_to" is null or "catalog_opening_hours"."valid_from" <= "catalog_opening_hours"."valid_to"

catalog_records_place_check.name: catalog_records_place_check
catalog_records_place_check.value: (("catalog_records"."kind" = 'place') = ("catalog_records"."place_category" is not null)) and ("catalog_records"."kind" <> 'place' or "catalog_records"."location" is not null)

catalog_records_event_check.name: catalog_records_event_check
catalog_records_event_check.value: "catalog_records"."kind" <> 'event' or ("catalog_records"."starts_at" is not null and "catalog_records"."ends_at" is not null and "catalog_records"."ends_at" > "catalog_records"."starts_at")

catalog_seasons_range_check.name: catalog_seasons_range_check
catalog_seasons_range_check.value: "catalog_seasons"."from_month" between 1 and 12 and "catalog_seasons"."to_month" between 1 and 12 and "catalog_seasons"."from_day" between 1 and 31 and "catalog_seasons"."to_day" between 1 and 31

place_images_wikimedia_check.name: place_images_wikimedia_check
place_images_wikimedia_check.value: "place_images"."source" <> 'wikimedia_commons' or ("place_images"."licence" is not null and "place_images"."attribution" is not null and "place_images"."source_page_url" is not null)

handoff_messages_pending_host_idx.name: handoff_messages_pending_host_idx
handoff_messages_pending_host_idx.where: host_notification_key is null and read_at is null

info_blocks_replaces_check.name: info_blocks_replaces_check
info_blocks_replaces_check.value: "info_blocks"."replaces_block_id" is null or "info_blocks"."unit_id" is not null

offers_destination_check.name: offers_destination_check
offers_destination_check.value: "offers"."provider_id" is null or "offers"."destination_id" is not null

offers_price_check.name: offers_price_check
offers_price_check.value: ("offers"."price_minor" is null and "offers"."order_kind" = 'request') or ("offers"."price_minor" is not null and "offers"."price_minor" between 0 and 10000000)

offers_live_check.name: offers_live_check
offers_live_check.value: (("offers"."availability_mode" = 'live') = ("offers"."adapter_kind" is not null)) and ("offers"."availability_mode" <> 'live' or "offers"."external_product_ref" is not null)

units_counts_check.name: units_counts_check
units_counts_check.value: ("units"."max_occupancy" is null or "units"."max_occupancy" between 1 and 50) and ("units"."bedrooms" is null or "units"."bedrooms" between 0 and 50) and ("units"."bathrooms" is null or "units"."bathrooms" between 0 and 50)
